text:
A zebra stands in stripes of black and white,
While gardens sleep in quietude’s embrace.
The flowers bloom, their silent vows take flight,
Unfurling petals in a soft embrace.

The trees stand guard, sentinels of old,
Their rustling leaves with ancient wisdom speak.
In this green haven, stories unfold,
Of growth’s simple peace, beyond all weak.

Here solace finds the heart in nature’s way,
Through bloom and wither, time’s eternal dance.
Each leaf that falls, each petal’s bright display,
Reveals the cycle of life’s quiet trance.
